citations.claim: EW approaches enter yellow at step 202 (phase EW yellow, E and W signals yellow)
yellow still active at step 204 - only 3rd second of yellow
controller already in all-red before NS at step 205, so EW yellow lasted only 3 s (202-204) instead of required 5 s - first violation at step 205

counterfactual.change: Set actuated from true to false (single field change to fixed-time). With identical steps, green/yellow/all_red timings, the yellow is no longer truncated and the yellow_duration rule passes.

explanation: Actuated controller shortens yellow below yellow_seconds. With actuated=true, EW yellow lasts only 3 s (steps 202-204) before transitioning to all-red at step 205, violating the required 5 s. With actuated=false (fixed-time) the same timing parameters produce a full 5 s yellow and no violation, indicating the actuated logic incorrectly truncates or miscounts the yellow interval (likely applying gap-out/max-green termination to the yellow phase).
vision_note: In steps 202-204 two opposite approaches show yellow (two yellow dots) while the cross direction stays red, indicating an active yellow phase. At step 205 all four approaches are red, so the yellow lasted only three steps (202-204) before going to all-red, visibly cut short.
